project.description: Build+deploy pic-sure-hpds-query-service (DB-free single HPDS ingress; /hpds/{auth,open}[/v3]/query|search). Builds services/pic-sure-hpds-query-service from the monorepo. git_hash defaults to the rewrite branch during migration.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash
CONFIG_DIR="/usr/local/docker-config/query" mkdir -p "$CONFIG_DIR"
# Build ONLY the services/pic-sure-hpds-query-service module (+ its reactor deps) from the pic-sure monorepo. # Never builds pic-sure-legacy (quarantined), so it cannot touch the frozen Java 11 line. docker run --rm \ -v "$DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR/jenkins_home/workspace/$JOB_NAME/:/app" \ -v maven_m2_cache:/root/.m2 \ -w /app \ --platform=linux/amd64 \ maven:3-amazoncorretto-25 \ sh -lc "mvn -B -pl services/pic-sure-hpds-query-service -am clean package -DskipTests"
# env-file cascade (uploaded param > existing config > warn) if [ -f query.env ]; then echo "A new query.env was loaded." cp query.env "$CONFIG_DIR/query.env" elif [ -f "$CONFIG_DIR/query.env" ]; then echo "Using existing query.env" else echo "WARNING: no query.env present -- required config (HPDS_AUTH_URL, HPDS_OPEN_URL," echo "OPERATIONS_SERVICE_URL, QUERY_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN) will be missing." echo "See $CONFIG_DIR/example.env for the full template." # Actuator is off by default in application.yml (the 'none' sentinel matches no endpoint). # The smoke check below polls /actuator/health, which 404s unless health is exposed, # so an empty env file could never produce a passing deploy. { echo "# Generated by this job. See example.env in this directory for every supported key." echo "PICSURE_ACTUATOR_EXPOSURE=health" } > "$CONFIG_DIR/query.env" fi
# build the runtime image (jar from the Maven step) docker build -t hms-dbmi/pic-sure-hpds-query-service:LATEST services/pic-sure-hpds-query-service/
# (re)deploy on the picsure network docker rm -f pic-sure-hpds-query-service 2>/dev/null || true docker run --name=pic-sure-hpds-query-service --restart always --network=picsure \ --env-file "$CONFIG_DIR/query.env" \ -d hms-dbmi/pic-sure-hpds-query-service:LATEST \ || exit 2
# smoke -- poll the service health from inside the network for i in $(seq 1 18); do if docker run --rm --network=picsure busybox wget -qO- http://pic-sure-hpds-query-service:8080/actuator/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "hpds-query-service is healthy." exit 0 fi sleep 5 done echo "ERROR: hpds-query-service did not become healthy within 90s" docker logs --tail 60 pic-sure-hpds-query-service exit 2
